svg.title: Jones and Mueller polarization calculation pipelines
svg.desc: Two parallel flows show a fully polarized Jones field and a general Stokes state passing through rotation, retarder, and polarizer matrices in rightmost-first order.
svg.text: Two state spaces, one composition rule
Jones: complex field, fully polarized light
Mueller: measurable Stokes state, including partial polarization
